section.div: Hammunition turns an existing Debian-family install into an amateur radio, SDR, and RF experimentation workstation. Primary target: Parrot OS. Also targeting Debian, Ubuntu, Kali, Linux Mint and Raspberry Pi OS.

Responder is a LLMNR, NBT-NS and MDNS poisoner, with built-in HTTP/SMB/MSSQL/FTP/LDAP rogue authentication server supporting NTLMv1/NTLMv2/LMv2, Extended Security NTLMSSP and Basic HTTP authentication.
